patch_description:
The current program uses 146 circuit parameters spread across independently tuned single-qubit layers, which increases optimization difficulty and produces a noticeable train-test gap. The fixed training loop, data re-uploading schedule (3 uploads, 2 repeats), and mean-Z readout remain unchanged, so the main lever is the ansatz block itself.

This rewrite replaces the wide per-qubit parameterization with a compact, symmetry-biased 6-parameter block:
- parity-split RY layers on even and odd qubits,
- two shared CRY entangling layers on alternating ring pairings,
- one shared RZ mixing layer,
- a final shared RX readout-alignment layer.

This keeps the circuit expressive enough to exploit repeated feature embeddings, but reduces parameter count to 38 total, improving parameter efficiency and typically helping validation/test generalization and convergence stability under Adam.
